review_scope: Read complete Chinese source snapshots for articles 21–25, drafted all 234 paragraphs per language (468 target paragraphs total), and reread every saved paragraph side by side with its Chinese source and the other translation. Reviewed all titles, decks, chapter labels and entry doors. Checked all examples, qualifications, modal scope, distinctions among apology, forgiveness, reconciliation and repair, and both parties' agency. Applied ten localized corrections during the reread. Ran renderer load validation, exact ordered HTML tag/link comparison, chapter-5 equality with reviewed index, source-byte preservation hashes, residual-CJK and Self-as-an-End checks.
limitations: Writer self-review only, not independent semantic acceptance. No public rendering, publication, source amendments, Git changes or articles 26–30 work. No new source decision identified in 21–25. Existing earlier source observations remain outside this scope and unchanged.

findings.explanation: Keep 相处 broad rather than implying a romantic couple.
findings.old: whether the two people will stay together
findings.replacement: whether the two people will continue their relationship

findings.explanation: Remove awkward repeated did without changing the acknowledgment.
findings.old: what I did did leave you out
findings.replacement: my actions really did leave you out

findings.explanation: Avoid darf nicht, which would prohibit forgiveness rather than permit withholding it.
findings.old: Wer verletzt wurde, darf nicht vergeben,
findings.replacement: Wer verletzt wurde, darf die Vergebung verweigern,

findings.explanation: Preserve the direction: resumed closeness is invoked to shut down renewed discussion.
findings.old: This makes renewed closeness conditional on no further discussion.
findings.replacement: This treats renewed closeness as grounds for no further discussion.

findings.explanation: Preserve the direction of the source condition rather than making closeness contingent on silence.
findings.old: Dieser Satz macht erneute Nähe davon abhängig, dass nicht mehr diskutiert wird.
findings.replacement: Dieser Satz macht aus erneuter Nähe einen Grund, nicht mehr zu diskutieren.

findings.explanation: Naturalize shared responsibility and boundary compatibility.
findings.old: They cannot share a certain direction, or cannot both meet a certain boundary.
findings.replacement: They cannot jointly commit to a certain direction, or cannot both accommodate a certain boundary.

findings.explanation: Restore non-determination rather than asserting the calm person lacks the better reasons.
findings.old: Doch wer zuerst wieder ruhig wird, hat deshalb nicht die besseren Gründe.
findings.replacement: Doch wer zuerst wieder ruhig wird, entscheidet nicht darüber, wer die besseren Gründe hat.

findings.explanation: Natural English for 证明对方过度.
findings.replacement: prove the other person is overreacting

findings.explanation: Naturalize ending another person’s hurt without implying physical healing.
findings.old: aber nicht deine Verletzung für dich beenden
findings.replacement: aber nicht an deiner Stelle bestimmen, wann deine Verletzung vorbei ist

findings.explanation: Naturalize the deck while preserving the distinction between one's denial and the other's hurt/trust.
findings.old: aber nicht für den anderen seine Verletzung beenden oder sein Vertrauen wiederherstellen.
findings.replacement: aber nicht für den anderen bestimmen, wann seine Verletzung vorbei ist oder sein Vertrauen zurückkehrt.
